title: PECS: Sum Into and Out Of Lists
prompt:
Implement two methods that demonstrate PECS signatures:
- `static double sum(List<? extends Number> src)` — producer side,
  returns the total as double.
- `static void fill(List<? super Integer> dst, int a, int b, int c)` —
  consumer side, appends a, b, c in order.

Then `static List<Number> demo()` returns a `List<Number>` produced by
calling `fill` on it and then `sum` over it — proving one method reads a
List<Number> and the other writes into it, exactly as the wildcards
promise.

tests.name: sum reads any Number list
tests.hint: List.of(1, 2.5, 3L) is List<? extends Number> — sum must accept it.

tests.name: fill writes into a supertype list
tests.hint: List<Object> is List<? super Integer> — fill must accept and append a, b, c.

tests.name: demo exercises both sides
tests.hint: demo() should fill(7,8,9) into its own list then return it.
